transcript.answer: Subsystem v0.11.2 wrote the MCP servers to a system-scope settings file, /agent/.ai-agent/gemini-settings.json, and pointed gemini-cli at it through GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH. gemini-cli refuses a system settings file whose parent directory isn't owned by root, and the pod runs as uid 1000. It printed "Security Warning: Skipping system settings file… Parent directory is not owned by root" and started with 0 tools. Before v0.11.2, the subsystem only rendered a recipe's mcp_servers for Claude, so Gemini pods had no Lore MCP at all. The fix came in subsystem v0.11.3 (#246). Its init merges the servers into the user settings file, /agent/.gemini/settings.json. This was proven working on 2026-09-23.
